text.p: South African mining group Gencor Ltd said on Monday it expected its base metal division Billiton to be floated in the range of 210 to 240 pence a share on the London Stock Exchange.

Billiton is expected to issue about 375 million new shares, giving it a market capitalisation of between 4.4 billion and 5.1 billion pounds, Gencor said in its prospectus. It estimated Billiton's attributable profit excluding exceptional items was at least $330 million in the year ended June 30, and published a pro forma dividend of 10 cents.
